detail.title: Yomobile
detail.body: Led web development during the early launch phase of YO Mobile, a cross-border telecom and super-app platform operating between Mexico and the U.S., working across both customer-facing and internal platforms. I collaborated closely with stakeholders, designers, and a Ukraine-based backend and data team to build and maintain the public website as well as an investor portal for analytics and company updates. My work spanned frontend development, and data-driven interfaces, including custom email templates, analytics integrations, and internal dashboards used for business intelligence and executive reporting.
